assets.label: Relaunch ad — "Made for your voice." (19 s, voiceover + music)
assets.prompt_used: Edit: prompts/instagram-wordmark-2026/edit-v3.json. Three 5 s image-to-video shots, each from its own key visual — 'Your ideas.' (creator sketching abstract doodles at a sunny café), 'Your people.' (friends on a rooftop at golden hour capturing the sunset), 'Your voice.' (creator pinning colourful photos to a studio wall) — then a static end card with the revised wordmark, 'Made for your voice.' and the CTA 'Update the app'. Voiceover: 'Every idea starts in your own hand. Every moment is better with your people. Every post, in your own voice. Instagram. Made for your voice.' Music: warm minimal instrumental bed. Supers typeset with ffmpeg; no text generated by a model. Prompts: prompts/instagram-wordmark-2026/v3/.

assets.label: Revised wordmark concept — print-style 'r', shown large and at app-header size
assets.prompt_used: Clean brand identity concept sheet for a wordmark reading exactly "Instagram". Problem to fix: in the current design a single cursive 'r' joined to the 'a' is misread as a different letter. Design direction: a bold, simple, modern script wordmark with one consistent joining rule; the 'r' has a clear print-style stem and shoulder and is unmistakably an 'r'; every letter is legible at a glance. Tone: confident, warm, crafted. Show the wordmark large in black on a plain warm-white background, plus the same wordmark at small app-header size underneath to prove legibility. Flat vector style, high contrast, no mockup clutter, no logos, no icons, no extra text besides the wordmark.
